disclaimer.full: AI-generated analysis based on statistical data. Outcomes remain unpredictable.

welcome.title: Turns thousands of sports data points into a single, intelligent analysis.
welcome.body: It analyzes form, performance, and match data across every sport — turning complex numbers into clear insights and showing the reasoning behind every result.

home.followBody: Get their matches and important changes here.

home.noMatchesForSport: No analysed matches in this sport right now.

insights.title: AI Insights
insights.subtitle: Discover SportMind's current view of your team. See their form, squad status, and recent developments in one place.
insights.followingEmptyBody: Follow up to {{max}} teams for free to see meaningful changes for them here.
insights.maxTeamsReached: You're following the maximum of {{max}} teams. Remove one to add another.
insights.noUpcomingMatch: {{team}} has no upcoming match to analyze right now.
insights.teamViewPositive: {{team}}'s {{signal}} has improved recently and is currently the team's strongest positive signal.
insights.teamViewNegative: {{team}}'s {{signal}} has declined recently and is currently the team's main concern.
insights.teamViewMixed: {{team}} shows mixed signals right now — {{positive}} has improved, while {{negative}} needs attention.
insights.teamViewStable: {{team}}'s underlying signals are steady right now, with no major positive or negative shifts.
insights.teamViewInsufficientData: There isn't enough recent data yet to show a trend for {{team}}.
insights.teamSignalsInfoBody: Form comes from the team's last 5 results. Attack and defence compare their real recent goals scored/conceded against their own prior run — shown only once there's enough history for a fair comparison.
insights.h2hRecord: In {{total}} previous meetings, {{team}} has won {{ownWins}}, drawn {{draws}}, lost {{oppWins}}.
insights.recentChangesEmpty: No changes yet. Check back once matches get closer to kickoff.
insights.noSignificantChanges: No significant changes since the last analysis.

matchAnalysis.whyDoesAiThink: Why does the AI think this?
matchAnalysis.methodologyNote: Confidence is calculated with a weighted statistical model from recent form, expected goals, and matchup context. It's an approximation, not a certainty.

myMatches.title: Saved matches
myMatches.note: Each match is analysed independently — these are separate analyses, not a combined outcome.
myMatches.emptyBody: Tap the bookmark icon on any match to save it here for quick access.

methodology.title: How our AI works
methodology.dataSourcesBody: Licensed match, form, and injury data updated continuously from official statistics providers.
methodology.confidenceBody: A weighted statistical model estimates likelihood from recent form, expected goals, and matchup context. It is an approximation, not a certainty.
methodology.whyChangeBody: New data — injuries, lineups, weather — can shift the model's output. Every material change is logged in "What changed?".
methodology.cannotDoBody: It cannot guarantee outcomes, predict with certainty, or account for every unpredictable event in a match.
methodology.modelPerformanceBody: The model correctly called these results before kickoff.
methodology.modelPerformanceEmpty: No finished matches to check yet — this fills in as real results come in.
methodology.trackRecordCalledDraw: Model correctly called the draw at {{pct}}% confidence
